description: Scrape Medium articles by tag, user, publication, search, or direct URL.

articleUrl.description: Full URL of a single Medium article (e.g. `https://medium.com/@username/article-title-abc123`).
articleUrl.title: Article URL (mode=byUrl)

containsKeyword.description: Only include articles whose title or preview text contains this keyword (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains Keyword

excludePaywalled.description: If true, skip articles that appear to be member-only (paywalled).
excludePaywalled.title: Exclude Paywalled Articles

fromDate.description: Only include articles published on or after this date (e.g. `2024-01-01`). Applied after fetching.
fromDate.title: Published After (ISO-8601 date)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of articles to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

enumTitles: By Tag/Topic — articles tagged with a specific topic
By User — articles by a Medium username
By Publication — articles from a Medium publication
Search — search Medium articles by keyword
By URL — single article metadata from a Medium URL
mode.title: Mode

publication.description: Medium publication slug as it appears in the URL (e.g. `better-programming`, `towards-data-science`).
publication.title: Publication Slug (mode=byPublication)

query.description: Keywords to search for on Medium.
query.title: Search Query (mode=search)

tag.description: Tag slug to fetch articles for. Choose from the dropdown or type a custom slug (e.g. `python`, `startups`, `ux`).
tag.title: Tag / Topic (mode=byTag)

title: Medium Article Scraper Input
